== Summary ==
Identified: none. The player in a green Salt & Ness cap, a long beard, a navy tee, and glasses is the same man as the standing green-cap player in [[:File:2022 Endor Grand Prix 17.jpg]], the laptop table in [[:File:2022 Endor Grand Prix 19.jpg]], and the standing green-cap player in [[:File:2022 Endor Grand Prix 55.jpg]]. Faces unlabeled.
The [[2022 Endor Grand Prix]] in Seattle, Washington (8–10 April 2022).
